title: Queen Beatrix wanted Slavery Monument in Amsterdam to focus on liberation, not victims
title_zh: 贝娅特丽克丝女王希望阿姆斯特丹的奴隶纪念碑着重展现解放，而非受害者。
description: Queen Beatrix wanted the National Slavery Monument in Amsterdam to commemorate only the end of slavery, not its victims.
description_zh: 贝娅特丽克丝女王希望阿姆斯特丹的国家奴隶制纪念碑只纪念奴隶制的结束，而不是纪念奴隶制的受害者。

title: Amsterdam man, 43, found dead in Hoofddorp woods; Suspect, 28, arrested
title_zh: 一名43岁的阿姆斯特丹男子被发现死于霍夫多普森林；一名28岁的嫌疑人被捕。
description: On Friday, the body of a 43-year-old man from Amsterdam was found in a wooded area in Hoofddorp.
description_zh: 周五，一名来自阿姆斯特丹的 43 岁男子的尸体在霍夫多普的一片树林中被发现。

title: University of Amsterdam apologizes for wartime firing of Jewish staff
title_zh: 阿姆斯特丹大学就战时解雇犹太员工一事道歉
description: The University of Amsterdam has apologized for the forced dismissal of Jewish staff members and resistance fighters during World War II.
description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹大学就二战期间强行解雇犹太教职工和抵抗战士一事道歉。

title: Dutch man, 37, from Hoeksche Waard arrested for drugging, raping, filming partner
title_zh: 来自 Hoeksche Waard 的 37 岁荷兰男子因吸毒、强奸、拍摄搭档被捕
description: A 37-year-old man from the municipality of Hoeksche Waard in Zuid-Holland is suspected of repeatedly drugging and raping his partner.
description_zh: 一名来自南荷兰省霍克斯赫瓦尔德市的 37 岁男子涉嫌多次给伴侣下药并强奸她。

title: Customers ignore hackers' demand to pay around €15 or have Flink data leaked to dark web
title_zh: 客户无视黑客提出的支付约 15 欧元或将 Flink 数据泄露到暗网的要求。
description: Hackers who stole customer data from the Dutchgrocery-delivery service Flink
description_zh: 黑客从荷兰生鲜配送服务公司 Flink 窃取了客户数据。

title: Ministry warns Dutch in France to avoid sometimes violent student protests
title_zh: 外交部提醒在法荷兰公民避免参与有时会演变成暴力冲突的学生抗议活动。
description: Dutch nationals in France are advised to avoid protests by school and university students across the country.
description_zh: 建议在法国的荷兰公民避开全国各地中小学生和大学生的抗议活动。

title: Person shot dead in Amsterdam-West; Police look for 1.80 meter tall man in his 30s
title_zh: 阿姆斯特丹西区发生枪击案，一人死亡；警方正在搜寻一名身高1.80米、30多岁的男子。
description: A person died in a shooting near Amsterlveensweg in Amsterdam-West around 2:30 a.m. near house number 21, according to emergency records.
description_zh: 据紧急记录显示，凌晨 2 点 30 分左右，在阿姆斯特丹西区 Amsterlveensweg 21 号房屋附近发生枪击事件，造成一人死亡。

title: House hunters can tour over 14,000 homes as Open House Day begins Saturday at 11 a.m.
title_zh: 购房者可以在周六上午 11 点开始的开放日活动中参观超过 14,000 套房屋。
description: House hunters can visit more properties Saturday from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. during the semiannual Open House Day organized by the real estate association NVM.
description_zh: 购房者可以在周六上午 11 点至下午 3 点期间参观更多房产，这是由房地产协会 NVM 组织的半年一度的开放日活动。

title: Amost two-thirds of Dutch support clothing rules in secondary schools; Women more strict
title_zh: 近三分之二的荷兰人支持中学制定着装规定；女性的规定更为严格。
description: Nearly two-thirds of the surveyed Dutch say that rules on what students should wear at are fine at secondary schools.
description_zh: 近三分之二的受访荷兰人表示，中学对学生着装的规定是合理的。

title: Report on House of Orange colonial role gets positive reception mixed with criticism
title_zh: 关于奥兰治家族殖民角色的报告获得了褒贬不一的评价。
description: Civil-society groups were overall pleased withthe reporton the role of the House of
description_zh: 民间社会团体总体上对关于下议院作用的报告感到满意。

title: Dutch fugitive Leijdekkers allegedly funnels billions in drug money into Sierra Leone
title_zh: 据称，荷兰逃犯莱德克斯向塞拉利昂输送了数十亿美元的毒资。
description: The alleged money and presence of notorious Dutch drug kingpin Jos Leijdekkers, also known as Bolle Jos, 35, has permeated the economy of Sierra Leone, where he is said to be hiding.
description_zh: 据称，臭名昭著的荷兰毒枭 Jos Leijdekkers（又名 Bolle Jos，现年 35 岁）的资金和存在已经渗透到塞拉利昂的经济中，据说他就藏身于此。

title: Five men released, remain suspects after unattended bags turn up at 4 train stations
title_zh: 五名男子获释，但仍是嫌疑人，此前在四个火车站发现了无人认领的行李包。
description: The five men that were arrested on Tuesday overluggage left at train stationsi
description_zh: 周二因将行李遗留在火车站而被捕的五名男子

title: ABN Amro also expects Dutch housing market to cool more sharply in 2027
title_zh: 荷兰银行也预计，荷兰房地产市场将在2027年出现更剧烈的降温。
description: ABN Amro expects the Dutch housing market to cool more significantly next year than it previously anticipated.
description_zh: 荷兰银行预计，明年荷兰房地产市场降温幅度将比此前预期更大。

title: All 10 AI chatbots tested point consumers to unlicensed online gambling sites
title_zh: 所有10个受测AI聊天机器人都会将消费者引导至未经许可的在线赌博网站。
description: According to the Keurmerk Verantwoorde Affiliates (KVA), which examines ten popular AI bots, such tools relatively easily expose Dutch consumers to unlicensed online gambling.
description_zh: 根据荷兰监管机构 Keurmerk Verantwoorde Affiliates (KVA) 对十款流行的 AI 机器人的调查，此类工具相对容易使荷兰消费者接触到未经许可的在线赌博。

title: Nearly two-thirds of summer hospitality businesses found violating food safety rules
title_zh: 近三分之二的夏季酒店餐饮企业被发现违反食品安全规定
description: During inspections last summer, the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA) found violations at nearly two-thirds of hospitality businesses that attract large crowds on hot da
description_zh: 去年夏天，荷兰食品和消费品安全局 (NVWA) 在检查中发现，近三分之二在炎热天气下吸引大量顾客的餐饮企业存在违规行为。

title: No trains to and from Amsterdam Centraal on Saturday; Fewer on Sunday and Monday
title_zh: 周六没有往返阿姆斯特丹中央车站的列车；周日和周一班次会减少。
description: No trains are running on Saturday to or from Amsterdam Centraal, Pro Rail reports. Fewer trains are expected on Sunday and Monday.
description_zh: 据Pro Rail报道，周六往返阿姆斯特丹中央车站的列车全部停运。预计周日和周一的列车班次也会减少。

title: Masked men that shot security guard in Overasselt were partly recruited on Snapchat
title_zh: 在奥弗阿塞尔特枪击保安的蒙面男子部分是通过Snapchat招募的。
description: The masked men arrested in Overasselt at the start of September for murdering security guard Berry Leenders and
description_zh: 9月初，在奥弗阿塞尔特被捕的蒙面男子因谋杀保安贝瑞·林德斯而被捕。

title: Mild, mostly dry weekend ahead; Next week to be wetter, cooler
title_zh: 周末天气温和，大部分时间干燥；下周天气转湿，气温下降。
description: This weekend is expected to be relatively dry and somewhat sunny. On Saturday and Sunday, the World Animal Day, the temperatures are expected to be at around 20 degrees Celsius.
description_zh: 预计本周末天气相对干燥，阳光充足。周六和周日是世界动物日，气温预计在20摄氏度左右。

title: Dutch government prepares vape tax as EU-wide measure remains pending
title_zh: 荷兰政府准备征收电子烟税，而欧盟范围内的类似措施仍待定。
description: State Secretary of Finance Eelco Eerenburg has drafted legislation to introduce an excise tax on vapes.
description_zh: 财政部国务秘书埃尔科·埃伦堡已起草立法，拟对电子烟征收消费税。

title: Rabobank, ABN Amro to significantly reduce maximum mortgage amount for older clients
title_zh: 荷兰合作银行和荷兰银行将大幅降低老年客户的最高抵押贷款额度
description: Rabobank and ABN Amro are both tightening their mortgage lending criteria for older borrowers.
description_zh: 荷兰合作银行和荷兰银行都在收紧对老年借款人的抵押贷款标准。

title: PM Jetten rules out reparations as activist returns royal ribbon over colonial study
title_zh: 杰登总理排除赔偿可能性，此前活动人士归还了因殖民研究而获得的皇家丝带。
description: There will be no reparations as a result of the study into the colonial roleplayed by the
description_zh: 对殖民者所扮演角色的研究结果不会导致任何赔偿。

title: Eyewear chain pulls Meta glasses off Dutch store shelves over social concerns
title_zh: 眼镜连锁店因社会问题将Meta眼镜从荷兰商店货架上撤下。
description: Hans Anders has suspended the sales of Meta’s AI and camera glasses for an indefinite period, a spokesperson for the optician’s chain has confirmed after a report from the AD.
description_zh: 据《AD》报道，眼镜连锁店 Hans Anders 的一位发言人证实，该连锁店已无限期暂停销售 Meta 的人工智能和摄像头眼镜。

title: Rotterdam mayor closes venue over concert by convicted rapper JoeyAK
title_zh: 鹿特丹市长因说唱歌手 JoeyAK 的演唱会而关闭演出场地。
description: Event venue Villa Thalia in Rotterdam will be closed for 24 hours following an order by the city’s mayor, Carola Schouten, the municipality has announced.
description_zh: 鹿特丹市政府宣布，根据市长卡罗拉·舒滕的命令，活动场地 Villa Thalia 将关闭 24 小时。

title: Young adults moving out from parents' homes choose Amsterdam more than any other city
title_zh: 离开父母家的年轻人选择阿姆斯特丹的人数超过其他任何城市。
description: In 2024, more than 174,000 people aged 18 to 30 left their parents’ homes, with The Hague drawing in a disproportionately large share of non-students,
description_zh: 2024年，超过17.4万名18至30岁的年轻人离开父母的家，其中海牙吸引了不成比例的大量非学生群体。

title: Economic impact of climate change can no longer be denied: Dutch central bank pres.
title_zh: 气候变化的经济影响不容否认：荷兰中央银行行长
description: It is no longer possible to deny the economic impact of climate change, says De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) President Olaf Sleijpen during a speech in Frankfurt.
description_zh: 荷兰中央银行（DNB）行长奥拉夫·斯莱彭在法兰克福的一次演讲中表示，气候变化带来的经济影响已不容否认。

title: Four arrested over alleged 8.5 million euro VAT fraud involving alcohol-free drinks
title_zh: 四人因涉嫌在无酒精饮料领域进行850万欧元增值税欺诈而被捕
description: Four men aged 33, 39, 54, and 68 from Enschede, Hengelo, and Leeuwarden have been arrested by the Fiscal Intelligence and Investigation Service (FiOD) on tax evasion charges.
description_zh: 来自恩斯赫德、亨厄洛和吕伐登的四名男子，年龄分别为 33 岁、39 岁、54 岁和 68 岁，因涉嫌逃税被财政情报和调查局 (FiOD) 逮捕。

title: Finance Min. pushed to again adjust Box 3 tax plans only 48 hours after presenting them
title_zh: 财政部长在提出第三类税收方案后仅48小时就再次施压要求调整这些方案。
description: The Tweede Kamer, the lower house of the Dutch parliament, has shot down the government’s plan to tax small savers and investors in Box 3.
description_zh: 荷兰议会下院（Tweede Kamer）否决了政府对 Box 3 中的小额储户和投资者征税的计划。

title: Lots of rail and roadworks scheduled in Netherlands this weekend
title_zh: 本周末荷兰将进行大量铁路和公路施工。
description: Those heading out and about using the train or road in the Netherlands this weekend had better check their travel planner and navigation apps first.
description_zh: 本周末计划在荷兰乘坐火车或公路出行的人们最好先查看一下他们的旅行计划和导航应用程序。

title: Dutch leading growing skeptism of social media; 70% call it a risk to democracy
title_zh: 荷兰民众对社交媒体的怀疑情绪日益高涨；70%的人认为社交媒体对民主构成威胁。
description: Skepticism of social media is growing worldwide, but nowhere as fast as in the Netherlands.
description_zh: 全球范围内对社交媒体的怀疑情绪日益增长，但在荷兰，这种增长速度尤为迅猛。

title: EU opens applications for free train passes for 18-year-olds
title_zh: 欧盟开放18岁青年免费火车票申请
description: On Thursday, the European Union openedapplicationsfor free travel passes that let 18-year-olds explore Europe, including the Netherlands.
description_zh: 周四，欧盟开放了免费旅行通行证的申请，允许 18 岁的年轻人探索欧洲，包括荷兰。

title: Study: Orange family backed colonialism and earned almost €576 million from it
title_zh: 研究：奥兰治家族支持殖民主义，并从中获利近5.76亿欧元。
description: The House of Orange-Nassau was “with conviction and without any substantial reservations” involved in Dutch colonialism.
description_zh: 奥兰治-拿骚家族“满怀信心，毫无保留地”参与了荷兰的殖民活动。

title: Dutch television turns 75 as survey reveals viewers’ most unforgettable moments
title_zh: 荷兰电视台迎来75周年，一项调查揭示了观众最难忘的时刻
description: Today is the 75th anniversary of the first official nationwide television broadcast in the Netherlands. The first official broadcast took place on Tuesday, October 2, 1951, at 8:15 p.m.
description_zh: 今天是荷兰首次全国电视广播75周年纪念日。首次正式广播于1951年10月2日星期二晚上8点15分播出。

title: Cops not prosecuted for fatally shooting knife-armed man in mental crisis in Rozenburg
title_zh: 罗森堡警方因枪杀一名持刀男子致其精神失常而未被起诉
description: Three police officers involved inthe fatal shootingof a man
description_zh: 三名警员卷入一起致命枪击案，一名男子不幸身亡。

title: Gazan Maastricht University student faces no criminal investigation over October 7 video
title_zh: 加赞·马斯特里赫特大学一名学生因10月7日的视频事件未面临刑事调查。
description: A Gazan student at Maastricht University who appeared to suggest in a video that he had been involved in the October 7 attack on Israel will not face further criminal investigation.
description_zh: 一名在马斯特里赫特大学就读的加沙学生，在一段视频中似乎暗示他参与了 10 月 7 日对以色列的袭击，将不会面临进一步的刑事调查。

title: Fries with that? Homes near Amsterdam TikTok queue sell for less
title_zh: 薯条配这个？阿姆斯特丹TikTok排队附近的房屋售价更低
description: Homes near Fabel Friet, an Amsterdam chip shop whose TikTok-fuelled queues have become one of the city’s more unlikely tourist...
description_zh: Fabel Friet是一家位于阿姆斯特丹的炸鱼薯条店，因TikTok的走红而排起长队，成为这座城市最意想不到的旅游景点之一。附近居民的房屋……

title: Cabinet backtracks on box 3 tax plans for small savings
title_zh: 内阁撤回了针对小额储蓄的第三类税收方案。
description: The cabinet has promised to rewrite part of its new tax plan for savings and investments, just two days after...
description_zh: 内阁承诺将修改其新的储蓄和投资税收计划的部分内容，而就在两天前……

title: Podcast: The MC Escher’s Budget Carousel Edition
title_zh: 播客：MC Escher 的廉价旋转木马版
description: Want to support the DutchNews podcast so we can afford self-defence classes against Rob Jetten? Click here to become a...
description_zh: 想支持 DutchNews 播客，让我们能负担得起对付 Rob Jetten 的自卫课程吗？点击这里成为……

title: Dutch royal house earned nearly half a billion from slavery
title_zh: 荷兰王室从奴隶贸易中获利近5亿。
description: The Dutch royal family, the House of Orange-Nassau, earned an estimated €576 million from slavery, mostly in the former Dutch...
description_zh: 据估计，荷兰王室奥兰治-拿骚家族通过奴隶贸易获利5.76亿欧元，其中大部分奴隶来自前荷兰殖民地……

title: Rivers too low for depth checks, leaving ships to risk stranding
title_zh: 河水水位过低，无法进行深度检查，导致船舶面临搁浅风险。
description: Rivers in the east of the Netherlands have fallen so low that the authorities can no longer measure whether ships...
description_zh: 荷兰东部的河流水位已经下降到当局无法再测量船只是否航行的程度……

title: Inflation rate rose slightly in August
title_zh: 8月份通货膨胀率略有上升。
description: New numbers from the Dutch statistics agency CBS show  the inflation rate rose slightly in August. The preliminary estimate from...
description_zh: 荷兰中央统计局（CBS）最新数据显示，8月份通胀率略有上升。初步估计显示……

title: The Netherlands had its first TV broadcast 75 years ago
title_zh: 荷兰的首次电视广播发生在75年前。
description: Seventy-five years ago today, the Dutch had their first opportunity to watch a television broadcast: a performance of the play...
description_zh: 75年前的今天，荷兰人第一次有机会观看电视广播：一场话剧演出……

title: Israeli group disrupts Delft screening of Gaza documentary Naza
title_zh: 以色列团体扰乱代尔夫特放映加沙纪录片《纳扎》
description: A premiere screening of the documentary Naza, which investigates the killing of civilians by the Israeli military in Gaza, was...
description_zh: 纪录片《纳扎》的首映式举行，该片调查了以色列军队在加沙杀害平民的事件……

title: At least 6 Dutch sports federations discriminate against trans & non-binary athletes
title_zh: 至少有6个荷兰体育协会歧视跨性别和非二元性别运动员。
description: At least six Dutch sports federations require trans and non-binary athletes to apply for a waiver or undergo a medical assessment to compete in the sport,
description_zh: 至少有六个荷兰体育协会要求跨性别和非二元性别运动员申请豁免或接受医学评估才能参加比赛。

title: Katwijk approves permits for $3 billion Eli Lilly pharmaceutical plant
title_zh: 卡特韦克批准了礼来公司价值30亿美元的制药厂建设许可
description: The American company Eli Lilly has received the green light to build a $3 billion pharmaceutical plant in Katwijk. The municipal council has approved its permit application.
description_zh: 美国礼来公司已获准在卡特韦克建造一座价值30亿美元的制药厂。市政委员会已批准其许可证申请。

title: Dutch man suspected of drugging and raping partner, sharing footage online
title_zh: 一名荷兰男子涉嫌给伴侣下药并强奸，并将视频上传至网络。
description: A 37-year-old man from Hoeksche Waard in Zuid-Holland is suspected of having drugged and raped his partner on several occasions.
description_zh: 一名来自南荷兰省霍克斯赫瓦德的 37 岁男子涉嫌多次给伴侣下药并强奸她。

title: Later retirements would only dent teacher shortage as more men enter primary education
title_zh: 随着更多男性进入小学教育阶段，晚些时候的退休潮只会缓解教师短缺问题。
description: The shortage of primary school and high school teachers will not be solved by allowing teachers to retire later; it will only lead to a slight dent in the shortage, the Netherlands Bureau for Econo
description_zh: 荷兰经济统计局指出，允许教师延迟退休并不能解决中小学教师短缺的问题；这只能略微缓解教师短缺的局面。

title: ShinyHunters: Hackers behind massive Odido data theft say website wasn't shuttered
title_zh: ShinyHunters：大规模窃取Odido数据的黑客称网站并未关闭
description: The website of the hacker group ShinyHunters has moved to a new address, the organization told
description_zh: 黑客组织 ShinyHunters 的网站已迁移至新地址，该组织表示。

title: High fuel prices push Dutch inflation to 3.4 percent in September
title_zh: 高油价推高荷兰9月份通胀率至3.4%。
description: Inflation in the Netherlands rose to 3.4 percent in September, according to a quick estimate by Statistics Netherlands (CBS). High fuel prices are driving the increase.
description_zh: 根据荷兰中央统计局（CBS）的初步估算，荷兰9月份通货膨胀率升至3.4%。高企的燃油价格是推高通胀的主要因素。

title: EU irritated by Dutch Min.'s claim that it halted Sierra Leone subsidies over Bolle Jos
title_zh: 欧盟对荷兰部长声称因博莱·乔斯事件而停止向塞拉利昂提供补贴的说法感到恼火
description: The European Commission is annoyed that Dutch Justice Minister David van Weel publicly claimed that it halted Sierra Leone’s development aid because of Bolle Jos.
description_zh: 欧盟委员会对荷兰司法部长戴维·范·维尔公开声称因博勒·乔斯而停止对塞拉利昂的发展援助感到恼火。

title: Late goal earns Oranje 2-2 draw with Greece
title_zh: 荷兰队凭借最后时刻的进球，2-2战平希腊队。
description: The Netherlands avoided a first defeat under head coach Xavi Hernandez on Thursday night, coming back from 2-0 down to...
description_zh: 周四晚，荷兰队在主教练哈维·埃尔南德斯的带领下避免了首场失利，他们在0-2落后的情况下最终逆转取胜……

title: Flight crew member caught smuggling 18 kg of cocaine at Schiphol Airport
title_zh: 一名机组人员在史基浦机场被抓获，当时他正在走私18公斤可卡因。
description: Dutch Customs discovered 18 kilograms of cocaine inside the luggage of an airline crew member at Schiphol on Tuesday. The drugs were found during a routine customs check.
description_zh: 周二，荷兰海关在阿姆斯特丹史基浦机场一名航空公司机组人员的行李中查获了18公斤可卡因。这些毒品是在例行海关检查中发现的。

title: Spain closes youth care home run by Dutch couple after reports of abuse
title_zh: 西班牙关闭了一家由荷兰夫妇经营的青少年护理院，此前有报道称该护理院存在虐待儿童行为。
description: The Spanish authorities have ordered Huize Soria, a Dutch-run youth home in Aspe, Alicante province, where Dutch minors with behavioral problems were placed, to stop providing youth care after an i
description_zh: 西班牙当局已下令位于阿利坎特省阿斯佩的荷兰籍青少年之家Huize Soria停止提供青少年照护服务。该机构曾收容有行为问题的荷兰未成年人。

title: Hundreds of Dutch women, girls filmed with Meta glasses on creep sites; Lawsuit planned
title_zh: 数百名荷兰女性和女孩被戴着Meta眼镜的视频上传至变态网站；计划提起诉讼
description: In recent months, hundreds, maybe even thousands, of Dutch women and girls have been
description_zh: 近几个月来，成百上千，甚至可能数千名荷兰妇女和女孩……

title: Air France-KLM and Lufthansa submit final bids for 44.9% of Portugese airline TAP
title_zh: 法航-荷航集团和汉莎航空提交了竞购葡萄牙航空公司TAP航空44.9%股份的最终报价。
description: Air France-KLM and Lufthansa have both submittedimproved final bidsfor a major stake
description_zh: 法航-荷航集团和汉莎航空均已提交了改进后的最终竞标方案，以争取获得主要股权。

title: "Request from higher up” made Curacao refuse Venezuelan opposition leader’s flight
title_zh: 库拉索拒绝委内瑞拉反对派领导人的登机请求，理由是“上级要求”。
description: Curaçao's aviation authorityrefused landing permissionfor a private aircraft
description_zh: 库拉索航空当局拒绝了一架私人飞机的降落许可。

title: Oranje come back from 2-0 down to salvage draw against Greece in UEFA Nations League
title_zh: 荷兰队在欧足联国家联赛中从0-2落后追至平局，最终战平希腊队。
description: Oranje managed to salvage a point away against Greece on Thursday after a poor first half in Thessaloniki.
description_zh: 周四，橙衣军团在塞萨洛尼基客场对阵希腊的比赛中，上半场表现糟糕，但最终还是艰难地拿到了一分。

title: 4 more people in the Netherlands die from West Nile virus; 56 total infections
title_zh: 荷兰新增4例西尼罗河病毒死亡病例；累计感染病例56例。
description: Four more people in the Netherlands have died from West Nile virus, according to the National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) said Thursday.
description_zh: 荷兰国家公共卫生与环境研究所（RIVM）周四表示，荷兰又有四人死于西尼罗河病毒。

title: Public transport unions threaten weekly strikes until Christmas
title_zh: 公共交通工会威胁将每周罢工直至圣诞节
description: The trade unions FNV and CNV are preparing to strike in regional public transport from October 12 if employers do not meet their demands.
description_zh: 如果雇主不满足工会的要求，FNV 和 CNV 工会准备从 10 月 12 日起在地区公共交通领域举行罢工。

title: PVV government's internal border controls come to an end
title_zh: PVV政府的内部边境管制结束
description: From today, the Koninklijke Marechaussee (KMar) is no longer conducting theinternal border checks i
description_zh: 从今天起，皇家宪兵队（KMar）不再进行内部边境检查。

title: Ebola-infected aid worker heading to Netherlands for treatment
title_zh: 感染埃博拉病毒的援助人员前往荷兰接受治疗
description: An Ebola-infected patient is coming to the Netherlands for treatment. The patient is an aid worker who contracted the virus while working in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).
description_zh: 一名感染埃博拉病毒的患者将前往荷兰接受治疗。该患者是一名援助人员，在刚果民主共和国（简称刚果（金））工作期间感染了病毒。

title: Amsterdam museum visits fall 5.2% as visitors spend less, stay for shorter time in city
title_zh: 阿姆斯特丹博物馆参观人数下降了5.2%，原因是游客消费减少，在市内停留时间缩短。
description: In the first half of this year, Amsterdam museums drew 5.2 percent fewer visitors than in the same period a year ago.
description_zh: 今年上半年，阿姆斯特丹博物馆的游客数量比去年同期减少了 5.2%。

title: 24-year-old man dies after stabbing at Alkmaar asylum reception center
title_zh: 一名24岁男子在阿尔克马尔难民接待中心被刺身亡
description: A fatal stabbing took place on Wednesday at the Central Agency for the Reception of Asylum Seekers (COA) reception location on Robonsbosweg in Alkmaar.
description_zh: 周三，在阿尔克马尔 Robonsbosweg 的中央难民接待机构 (COA) 接待处发生了一起致命的刺伤事件。

title: More young adults use drugs in Amsterdam’s nightlife, not alcohol; Gambling on the rise
title_zh: 在阿姆斯特丹的夜生活中，年轻人吸毒的比例高于饮酒的比例；赌博活动日益增多。
description: Young adults aged 18-27 who go out in Amsterdam drink less alcohol but use more drugs, such as ketamine or 3-MMC, according to a new report from
description_zh: 根据一份最新报告显示，阿姆斯特丹18至27岁的年轻人外出饮酒量较少，但吸食毒品（例如氯胺酮或3-MMC）的量却更多。

title: Water authorities warn flea and tick treatments can harm water quality
title_zh: 水务部门警告：跳蚤和蜱虫防治可能会损害水质。
description: In anticipation of World Animal Day, the water boards of the Netherlands have urged pet owners to be responsible when using products against fleas and other parasites.
description_zh: 在世界动物日到来之际，荷兰水务局敦促宠物主人在使用除蚤和其他寄生虫产品时要负责任。

title: Real estate agents to face mandatory register as self-regulation
title_zh: 房地产经纪人将面临强制注册，以进行自我监管。
description: The government plans to introduce a register of real estate agents as well as a complaints desk for buyers and...
description_zh: 政府计划建立房地产经纪人登记制度，并设立购房者投诉受理处……

title: Dutch museum visits rose to over 30m last year
title_zh: 去年荷兰博物馆参观人数超过3000万人次。
description: More than 30 million people visited a museum in the Netherlands in 2025, a 2.5% increase over the year prior,...
description_zh: 2025年，荷兰的博物馆参观人数超过3000万人次，比上一年增长2.5%……

title: Golf to a Japanese garden: 13 great things to do in October
title_zh: 从高尔夫球场到日式花园：十月必做的 13 件精彩事
description: It’s October and the cultural season is off to a good start. There are lots of restful established names in...
description_zh: 十月已至，文化季也拉开了帷幕。许多知名的休闲场所都已开放……

title: Foreign-born people aged 55+ face higher poverty risk than those born in the Netherlands
title_zh: 55岁及以上的外国出生人士比在荷兰出生的人士面临更高的贫困风险。
description: The number of people aged 55 and older born outside of the Netherlands rose sharply between 2012 and 2024, according to Statistics Netherlands (CBS).
description_zh: 根据荷兰统计局 (CBS) 的数据，2012 年至 2024 年间，55 岁及以上出生于荷兰境外的人口数量急剧上升。

title: Landlords warn higher Box 3 tax hikes will trigger another rental home sell-off
title_zh: 房东警告称，第三类房产税（Box 3）上调将引发新一轮出租房抛售潮。
description: Vastgoed Belang, the trade association representing private landlords, thinks it is unacceptable that the tax on assets in box 3 will be raised for landlords.
description_zh: 代表私人房东的行业协会 Vastgoed Belang 认为，提高房东在第 3 栏资产上的税额是不可接受的。

title: Imprison violent crime convicts far from home: Trade union after prison guard's killing
title_zh: 狱警遇害后，工会呼吁将暴力犯罪罪犯关押在远离家乡的地方：
description: Thefatal shooting of a prison guard in Amsterdam-Noorddemonstrates
description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹北部示威区发生狱警遭枪击身亡事件

title: Europe stops aid to Sierra Leone over refusal to extradite Dutch drug fugitive Bolle Jos
title_zh: 欧洲因塞拉利昂拒绝引渡荷兰毒贩博勒·乔斯而停止对塞拉利昂的援助
description: The European Commission has halted all aid to Sierra Leone over the African country’s refusal to extradite Dutch drug trafficker Jos Leijdekkers, Minister David van Weel of Justice and Se
description_zh: 由于塞拉利昂拒绝引渡荷兰毒贩约斯·莱德克斯，欧盟委员会已停止对塞拉利昂的所有援助。司法部长戴维·范·韦尔表示。

title: Amsterdam housing market cooling off, could spread to other cities
title_zh: 阿姆斯特丹房地产市场降温，这种情况可能会蔓延到其他城市。
description: The Amsterdam housing market is cooling down, and the rest of the Netherlands will likely follow suit, Parool
description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹的房地产市场正在降温，荷兰其他地区可能也会步其后尘，Parool 报道。

title: Dutch scientists develop clitoral reconstruction 40 years after first penis procedure
title_zh: 荷兰科学家在首次阴茎手术40年后研发出阴蒂重建技术
description: Four decades after men, it is now also possible for women to have reconstructive surgery after losing part of their sexual organs to cancer.
description_zh: 继男性之后四十年，女性现在也可以在因癌症失去部分性器官后进行重建手术。

title: Dutch gov't takes over regulation of real estate agents after consistent complaints
title_zh: 在接到大量投诉后，荷兰政府接管了房地产经纪人的监管工作。
description: With some reluctance, Housing Minister Elanor Boekholt-O’Sullivan (D66) is stepping in to regulate real estate agents.
description_zh: 尽管有些不情愿，住房部长埃拉诺·博克霍尔特-奥沙利文（D66）还是介入了房地产经纪人的监管工作。

title: Dutch ophthalmologists warn of sharp rise in serious eye injuries from padel
title_zh: 荷兰眼科医生警告称，板式网球造成的严重眼部损伤病例急剧增加。
description: Dutch ophthalmologists are reporting a sharp recent increase in serious eye injuries caused by padel.
description_zh: 荷兰眼科医生报告称，近期由板式网球引起的严重眼外伤病例急剧增加。

title: New law to provide clarity on when a worker qualifies as a freelancer
title_zh: 新法将明确规定劳动者何时符合自由职业者的定义
description: After years of debate about fake self-employment, Minister Thierry Aartsen of Employment is working on a new law to resolve the question of when someone qualifies as a freelancer and when
description_zh: 经过多年关于虚假自雇问题的争论，就业部长蒂埃里·阿尔岑正在制定一项新法律，以解决何时才能认定某人是自由职业者以及何时才能被认定为正式自雇人士的问题。

title: Rhenen town hall vandalised after asylum seeker housing approved; Riot police intervene
title_zh: 雷嫩市政厅在难民安置计划获批后遭到破坏；防暴警察介入。
description: Two windows at the town hall in Rhenen, Utrecht, were smashed with fireworks Wednesday night, after which riot police were deployed.
description_zh: 周三晚间，乌得勒支省雷嫩镇市政厅的两扇窗户被烟花砸碎，随后防暴警察被部署到现场。
